title: Maximal electrocatalytic activity of Sr-doped Nd1−xSrxMnO3 perovskite oxides (x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3) towards ORR: for next-generation power systems
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,13408-13419
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00332J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
B. B. Nayak, R. R. Das, P. Parida, P. Parhi
Nd1−xSrxMnO3 perovskite oxides (x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3), designated as NSM-0.9, NSM-0.8, and NSM-0.7, were prepared by Sol–Gel method and their electrocatalytic properties towards ORR was evaluated.
